podcast.body: Released on July 14, 1998, this album was a major commercial success, debuting at number one and selling 681,000 copies in its first week in the U.S. alone. It featured the single "Intergalactic," known for its intricate sampling. "It was ready by July 14, 1998, and they called it Hello Nasty. Another number one. This time selling 681,000 copies in its first week in the U.S. alone."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This album (commonly known as *Hello Nasty*) earned the Beastie Boys multiple Grammys in 1998, specifically within the realm of alternative music, helping to define their unique position between rap and alternative music. "Ellos son uno de los gramas que consiguieron que fue en 1998 con el gelo Nasty, a lo consiguieron al mejor al mundo de música alternativa."

podcast.body: This album (commonly known as *Hello Nasty*), for which the band received several Grammys, is among the four Beastie Boys albums listed in Rolling Stone's "500 Greatest Albums of All Time." "el grandísimo gelo nazt, por el que consiguieron varios gramis."
